machining.fire_risk: Fine chips, turnings and dust can ignite readily. Fire response must be specifically designed for magnesium.
machining.rule: Do not treat magnesium swarf as ordinary steel/aluminium swarf.

forming.cold_forming: Limited by alloy and temperature; wrought texture can create directional behaviour.
forming.warm_forming: Potentially useful for difficult shapes; process window is alloy-specific.

casting.design_implication: Casting process and defect population must remain attached to property evidence.

additive_manufacturing.rule: Requires dedicated process qualification; conventional wrought/cast properties must not be substituted.
